{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
num_test_orders = len(test_orders)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print required values
print(f'Number of test orders: {num_test_orders}')
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
